text:
sam: Drafting the release notes + changelog for Routing rollout + SDK snippet alignment. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7077 PTAL
hina: Quick read. Two asks: (1) add a compact Dedicated migration checklist, (2) call out deep-link changes in Console so customers know bookmarks may need updates
sam: added migration checklist (pin variant -> run preflight evals -> warm prefix cache -> monitor p95 & token-quality for 24h). wrote a short Console deep-link note. PTAL
lee: small nit: Python snippet still uses old import `from redwood.sdk.v0 import Client`  switch to `from redwood import Client`. Also JS streaming method changed to `client.text.createStream`
sam: fixed Python + JS examples and added a brief code comment showing legacy -> new mapping for quick copy-paste
qa-bot: snippet-tests queued
qa-bot: snippet-tests: streaming example flaky on first run (timeout). Retrying with extended timeout
qa-bot: snippet-tests: passed on retry. docs-lint: markdown wrap warnings fixed
link-bot: linkcheck: internal 404: /guides/dedicated/pin -> /guides/dedicated/variant-pinning suggested. External https://thirdparty.example/quant -> 410 archived; converted to inline advisory
sam: updated internal link and removed dead external link. inlined a short matrix about quant compatibility instead
ops: ops request: include rollout cadence and rollback triggers for SEs/Support. Suggest: canary 5% for 3h, 25% for 12h, 100% after 24h if metrics stable. Rollback on error-rate > 1% sustained 5m or p95 latency +40%
sam: added rollout cadence and a tiny ops playbook snippet (Prometheus alert examples). Also added a one-line "what to expect": brief latency variance during prefix-cache warmup; streaming embedding token counts may shift by ~1 token for some legacy quant builds
hina: recommend adding a short preflight eval curl so customers can run a quick smoke test when pinning variants
sam: added preflight eval example: ```bash
# preflight eval: run 3 prompts against pinned variant
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/evals.batch_run \
  -d '{"model":"kestrel-13b-quant","prompts":["Test A","Test B","Test C"]}'
```
lee: small editorial: shorten the changelog bullet to one line for release: "Routing v2: adaptive routing, variant pinning, and graceful quantized fallbacks (see docs)."
sam: shortened the changelog blurb and added a short migration checklist for Dedicated support handoff: bullet steps + sample warmup loop
ops: add warmup guidance for large fleets: recommend ramp at 5 RPS per GPU, include exponential backoff on 429s. Sample safe warmup loop provided
sam: included warmup guidance and this snippet: ```bash
# safe warmup: 5 RPS per GPU, backoff on 429s
for i in {1..60}; do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text.generate \
    -d '{"model":"kestrel-13b","input":"warmup"}' || true
  sleep 0.2
done
```
hina: docs-ci preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/7077/relnotes-routing-migration. Linkcheck shows all internal links OK in preview
lee: LGTM. I'll leave a final quick pass in 8m. Plan to merge and schedule publish 09:00 UTC tomorrow unless objections
ops: thumbs up from infra side. Recommend posting a short migration checklist to #support when live
sam: merging in 5m. Will schedule publish and post to #announcements + #support with links and a 1-paragraph migration summary. Thanks team! :shipit:
